changeSet.sql: UPDATE ${currency.table} cr SET expiry_date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE deployment_version = '${prev.version.number}'

INSERT INTO ${currency.table} (currency_code, rate, decimals, description, deployment_version, effective_date, expiry_date, created_at) SELECT tr.currency_code, tr.rate, tr.decimals, tr.description, '${version.number}' as deployment_version, CURRENT_DATE as effective_date, '9999-12-31' as expiry_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as created_at FROM ${temp.table} tr;
